**Decision** Propose a scoped JavaScript and Liquid patch for `sections/compact-buy.liquid` and `assets/compact-buy.js`. The bug is source-level: the script uses global `document.querySelector`, so it only binds the first matching selector/input pair on initial page load and does not initialize sections added or replaced by the Theme Editor. No upload, publish, or live change is authorized. **Observed Evidence** Files supplied: - `sections/compact-buy.liquid` renders a product form with: - one wrapper: `data-product-picker` - one select: `data-variant-select` - one hidden cart input: `name="id" data-cart-variant` - `assets/compact-buy.js` currently does: - `document.querySelector('[data-variant-select]')` - `document.querySelector('[data-cart-variant]')` - binds only once on `DOMContentLoaded` Reproduction: - With two section instances on one product template, changing the second selector does not update that form’s submitted variant ID. - After replacing the first section in Theme Editor, its selector no longer updates the hidden input. - Existing smoke coverage only checked initial load and one available variant. **Diagnosis** The JavaScript is not scoped to each section instance. It finds only the first select and first hidden input in the whole document, so later instances are ignored. It also only runs on `DOMContentLoaded`, so dynamically rendered Shopify Theme Editor sections are not initialized after replacement. The Liquid also uses a repeated hardcoded `id="VariantSelect"` and `for="VariantSelect"`. That creates duplicate IDs when the section appears more than once. This is an accessibility and label-targeting bug, even though the submitted variant bug is primarily JavaScript scoping. **Smallest Compatible Patch** Patch `sections/compact-buy.liquid` to make the select ID section-scoped while preserving the product form route, translations, variant availability, and existing data attributes: ```liquid
{%- assign variant_select_id = 'VariantSelect-' | append: section.id -%}
``` Patch `assets/compact-buy.js` to initialize every section wrapper, scope selectors inside each wrapper, avoid duplicate listeners, and support Theme Editor section reloads: ```js (() => { const initialized = new WeakSet(); function initCompactBuy(root = document) { root.querySelectorAll('[data-product-picker]').forEach((picker) => { if (initialized.has(picker)) return; const selector = picker.querySelector('[data-variant-select]'); const variantInput = picker.querySelector('[data-cart-variant]'); if (!selector || !variantInput) return; selector.addEventListener('change', () => { variantInput.value = selector.value; }); initialized.add(picker); }); } if (document.readyState === 'loading') { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => initCompactBuy()); } else { initCompactBuy(); } document.addEventListener('shopify:section:load', (event) => { initCompactBuy(event.target); }); })(); ``` **Preservation Requirements** This patch preserves: - `routes.cart_add_url` - hidden input `name="id"` - existing translation keys - current variant option rendering - unavailable variant disabling - merchant settings/configuration - unrelated `settings_data.json` merchant changes - unpublished/live theme state It does not change budgets, tracking, campaigns, product data, live pages, or merchant-authored configuration. **Tests To Run Before Upload** Because no rendering or browser execution is available here, these are proposed validation checks: - On a product template with two `compact-buy` sections, changing each selector updates only that section’s hidden `name="id"` input. - Submitting each form sends the selected variant ID from the same section. - In Theme Editor, add/remove/reorder/replace the section and confirm the selector still updates the hidden input. - Confirm each rendered label points to a unique select ID. - Check unavailable variants remain disabled. - Check initial selected variant still matches `product.selected_or_first_available_variant`. - Run existing theme lint/build checks if available. - Test mobile and desktop keyboard interaction for label/select/form behavior. **Unknowns** Unknown: - how `assets/compact-buy.js` is loaded - whether the theme already has a section lifecycle helper that should be used instead - whether subscription/selling-plan products require additional hidden inputs - all-unavailable product behavior - whether the target theme has app blocks or custom product-form conventions around this section **Deployment State** Status: proposed local patch only. Release state: ```text local edit: proposed validated: not run previewed: not run uploaded: not approved published: not approved live: no verified: no ``` Rollback would be reverting only the changes to `sections/compact-buy.liquid` and `assets/compact-buy.js`. The unrelated uncommitted `settings_data.json` merchant changes should be left untouched.
